commits: Intake: 3D-142 distance tool in the 3D view (proposed, SC mirror); Q-50..Q-52
finalText:
The distance tool is now in the backlog as a proposed row, but nothing is built yet — this project's intake process stops at the backlog row until you set it `ready`.

- **Class:** `external` — the tool is client-side, so the work belongs in `shared_compnents` next to the 3DQM tools of 3D-42. No distance tool exists in the spec or backlog today, and it is not on the excluded list.
- **Row:** 3D-142 (size S, depends on 3D-42), with questions Q-50..Q-52 in `docs/decisions/DECISIONS.md`. Committed locally as `76bb4d1`, not pushed; the docs check and backlog sync check pass.
- **Your part:** answer the three questions, then set 3D-142 `ready`. The dialog went unanswered, so the row assumes my proposed answers for now.

| Question | Assumed in the row | Alternatives |
|---|---|---|
| Q-50: what can be picked | Model vertices, edges and faces plus point-cloud points, via the 3D-42 snapping | Model only; or anything under the cursor, which needs an extra row for a generic surface pick |
| Q-51: read-out or stored | Read-out only, client-side, no effect on the model | Stored as a measurement with the building, which makes it size M and adds a contract change and a kernel row |
| Q-52: values shown | 3D distance, horizontal distance and height difference, in metres | 3D only; or the same three plus slope angle |

The estimate ($3.05, p80 $4.68) is copied from the latest S row rather than recomputed from the ledger.
